body:
# HAPPYPACK - Minecraft resource pack
Welcome to __Happypack!__ This simple, sleek resource pack adds cute (and sometimes creepy!) smiles to common blocks. It is designed for people who are getting bored of normal ol' Minecraft and would prefer a new, funny alternative while still maintaining a vanilla-like feel.
## Features
* Adds cute and funny faces to most blocks and entities you come across!
* Make ores really funny to find with their shiny, unique faces!
* Includes some UI elements, like hearts and menu buttons!
## Compatibility
* __Versions__: Optimized for the latest versions of Minecraft (26.1+), but works across most versions by overriding standard block and entity textures.
* __Load Order__: To ensure these bold faces override everything else, make sure Happypack sits at the __very top__ of your Active Resource Packs list.
